x-sdem-source.locator: assignment (active structure assigned to behaviour or object)

owner.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Who is accountable for this? Accountability is the most-asked design question. No public standard defines an "owner" field: Dublin Core's rightsHolder is about rights, not accountability. Built on ArchiMate's assignment of an actor or role.
